snippet.title: Volkolak: The Will of Gods - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of dark Slavic fantasy: Volkolak: The Will of Gods will be available in Early Access in August 2025!🐺

Dear adventurers, we have been silent for a long time, immersed in the creative process of development, and now we are finally ready to share the good news! In 22 August 2025, Chapter 1 of Volkolak: The Will of the Gods will be available on Steam.

Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through the Far-Away State. You will encounter mythical bosses, locations full of mysteries, and the opportunity to uncover ancient secrets. It's coming very soon — don't miss your chance to be part of this epic story!

Experience the challenge of a soulslike metroidvania as you overcome difficult boss fights and test your skills! Your journey awaits!

ADD TO WISHLIST!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499040/Volkolak_The_Will_of_Gods/?beta=1
